name: lemma
description: Source-linked JSONL chunks from Solidity compiler inputs and Markdown documents.

interface.shortDescription: Source-linked JSONL chunks from Solidity compiler inputs and Markdown documents.
interface.longDescription: Lemma turns Solidity compiler standard JSON input or a Markdown tree into validated JSONL chunks with source locations and separate quotation, model, and embedding text. It stops before embedding, indexing, retrieval, answering, or evaluation. Callable-surface ABI validation does not yet independently check return types or state mutability.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $lemma to turn Solidity or Markdown sources into validated JSONL chunks.
